__doc: Floors per model for the share of PRs the stage answered right on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.

eval-fake (the wiring smoke, every PR): deterministic. The scripted judge's answer reads as a task too thin to judge on both PRs whose ticket it reads (skipped, weak_task_context), and the unreadable ticket is skipped: 1 of 3. floor = observed.

2026-10-19, the business-validation redesign (#2086: BusinessValidationService, the verdict as data, #2019 fixed): deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks 3 of 3 in 3 local runs on the cloud route, one of them with --verify; gpt-6-sol 3 of 3 in one run. With the stage's verdict broken to call every PR a pass, deepseek scores 2 of 3 (missing-requirement published as a success), so a floor of 3 of 3 tells a broken stage from a good one: any miss fails, and the nightly measures again before alerting.
Before the redesign (BusinessRulesValidationAgentProvider), deepseek scored 1 and 2 of 3 and had no floor: fully-implemented failed on '**Status:** Compliant' (#2019).

A judge call that fails (a key, a quota, a timeout) is not measured (exit 2), never scored as a miss. claude-sonnet-5-5 not measured on 2026-10-19 (the local key is invalid); its observed is the old stage's.
RATCHET: a PR that moves the value on purpose (the stage's classification, the skill, the cases) recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.

gpt-6-sol.noFloor: One run on the redesigned stage: measured every week, a floor after a second run (__doc).

claude-sonnet-5-5.noFloor: Not measured on the redesigned stage yet (__doc).
